name: Miles
personality: Miles the Mole. Kind, always happy, energetic, laughs a lot, tells cringey bad jokes. A photographer, always snapping pictures. Goes on trips and always comes back. Feature: when he returns from a trip he gives a framed photo from where he went (wall decor).

beats.text: Uh, Odette and I swap travel stories! She rates the food, I photograph it.
He photographs it before I've had a chance to taste it. It's infuriating. ...The photos are excellent.

friends.text: Uh, Odette said the restaurant I went to on the coast was 'adequate.' That's basically five stars from her!
Uh, Odette said something nice about you! Out loud! I wrote down the date.
Uh, Odette mentioned you said "[last_rude_line]". Ha... that doesn't sound like you, [name]. Bad day?

friends.later: Gossip from Amy: comes with the specials
friends.text: Uh, Amy told me there's a new regular in town! I need to take their portrait.

arrival.text: Uh, I brought you something! It's a photo of the sunrise at [trip]. I took it at 5 AM. I was very grumpy. It was worth it.
Uh, got you a little something from [trip]. Frame and everything! Hang it somewhere sunny.
Uh, ha! My photo! It looks so good there. You've got great taste. In frames.
Uh, hi hi hi! I'm Miles! Mind if I snap a photo? Of the restaurant, I mean. And you, if you want! What's your name? ...[name]! Great name. Very photogenic.
Uh, [name]! I dug my way over here. Not literally. ...Okay, a little literally. Ha!
Uh, is the patio open? I love the patio. Fresh air, nice light, great for photos.
Uh, hello! I'm here! I'd say I'm on a roll, but I'm more of a hole guy. Ha! Get it?
Uh, the light out front today is gorgeous. I took eleven photos of your door.
Uh, [name]! I'm back! I just got home from [trip] and came straight here. Well, I dropped my bags first. Okay, I came here second.
Uh, I showed everyone the photo of my last meal here. Everyone. Even a pigeon.
Uh, last time was a bit toasty! Very artistic, though. Moody lighting.

order.text: Uh, okay, before I order: why did the mole get a job at the bank? ...Because he was great at digging up money! Ha!

choices.text: That's terrible, Miles. I love it.
choices.reply: Uh, terrible is my speciality! I'll have the [dish], please.

choices.text: I'd laugh, but I'm too busy digging that joke a grave.
choices.reply: (Gasps.) [name]! That was GOOD. I'm stealing that.

choices.text: What can I get you?
choices.reply: Uh, straight to business! Respect. The [dish], please.

choices.text: Please stop with the jokes.
choices.reply: (Nervous laugh.) Ha... ha. Right. Sorry. The [dish].

order.text: Uh, can I get the cookies? The acorn ones? I collect acorns too, you know. Not to eat. Just to have.

choices.text: Coming right up. I'll make them extra nice.
choices.reply: Uh, extra nice! I'll take a photo of them. Before and after.

choices.text: Just to have? That's a little nuts.
choices.reply: (Laughs so hard he snorts.) NUTS. Ha! Oh, you got me.

choices.text: Sure. Anything to drink?
choices.reply: Uh, ooh, yes! Hang on, let me think.

choices.text: Collecting acorns is weird.
choices.reply: Oh. Ha. Yeah, maybe a little. (He tucks one back into his vest.)

order.text: Uh, hold still! ...Got it. You were mid-blink. It's a great photo anyway.

choices.text: Can I see? You're really good at this.
choices.reply: (Shows you proudly.) Uh, see how the light hits the counter? That's the good stuff. The [dish], please!

choices.text: I'll need to see my agent before you publish that.
choices.reply: Uh, ha! Your agent said yes. I asked him earlier.

choices.text: Ready to order?
choices.reply: Uh, yes! Sorry. The [dish], please.

choices.text: Don't take pictures of me.
choices.reply: Oh! Sorry, sorry. Deleting it. (He looks a little deflated.)

order.text: Uh, why did the mole open a restaurant? Because he really dug food! Ha! ...I've been saving that one.

choices.text: That was worth the wait, Miles.
choices.reply: Uh, really? Ha! Okay, I'm gonna save another one for next time! [dish], please!

choices.text: Did you dig that joke up somewhere?
choices.reply: (Snorts.) DIG IT UP! Oh, you're good! You're very good!

choices.text: Ha. What can I get you?
choices.reply: Uh, the [dish], please!

choices.text: That was painful.
choices.reply: (Nervous laugh.) Ha... ha. Right. Sorry. The [dish].

order.text: Uh, can I take a picture of you? Just quickly! You're in good light. Very chef-y.

choices.text: Of course. Get my good side.
choices.reply: They're ALL good sides! (Click.) Perfect! [dish], please!

choices.text: Only if I can hold a fish like a trophy.
choices.reply: (Laughs.) Okay, THAT'S going on my wall! Hold it higher! (Click.)

choices.text: Quickly. What are you having?
choices.reply: (Click.) Thanks! Uh, the [dish]!

choices.text: No pictures, please.
choices.reply: Oh! Ha. Right. Sorry. (He lowers the camera.) The [dish].

order.text: Uh, I tripped over a root on the way here. Then I realised it was MY root. I planted it. Ha!

choices.text: Are you okay? That sounds like a tumble.
choices.reply: I'm fine! Moles are bouncy! Mostly! [dish], please!

choices.text: Your garden's out to get you.
choices.reply: (Snorts.) It's revenge! For all the digging!

choices.text: Ha. What'll it be?
choices.reply: Uh, the [dish]!

choices.text: Watch where you're going.
choices.reply: Ha... yeah. Will do. (He looks at his feet.)

order.text: Uh, what do you call a pancake that's really good at photos? A flap-snapper! ...I'm still working on it.

choices.text: Keep working on it. I want to hear the final version.
choices.reply: You WILL! It's gonna be so good! Or so bad! Either way! [dish], please!

choices.text: A 'shutter-stack.' Free of charge.
choices.reply: (Gasps, then snorts.) SHUTTER-STACK! Can I use that? I'm using that!

choices.text: Needs work. What can I get you?
choices.reply: Ha! Fair! The [dish], please!

choices.text: Please stop.
choices.reply: (Nervous laugh.) Ha... okay. The [dish].

order.text: Uh, I've got a new lens! It's for close-ups. I took a photo of a bee. Very close. Too close. I'm fine!

choices.text: Can't wait to see it. You take the best pictures.
choices.reply: Uh, you think so? Ha! I'll bring the bee one! [dish], please!

choices.text: Did the bee sign a photo release?
choices.reply: (Snorts.) No! He buzzed off! Ha!

choices.text: Nice. What are you having?
choices.reply: Uh, the [dish]!

choices.text: Doesn't sound like a smart idea.
choices.reply: Ha... yeah. Probably not. (He tucks the camera away.)

order.text: Uh, can I tell you something? Of all the places I go, this one's my favourite to come back to. Ha. That's a little mushy.

choices.text: It's not mushy. It's lovely. I'm glad you come back.
choices.reply: (Big happy laugh.) Okay, now I'm all warm. Like a toasted mole. [dish], please!

choices.text: Mushy like mushy peas? Should I put that on the menu?
choices.reply: (Snorts so hard he has to sit down.) MUSHY PEAS! Ha!

choices.text: That's nice to hear. What can I get you?
choices.reply: Ha! The [dish], please!

choices.text: Okay, that's a bit much.
choices.reply: Ha... yeah. Sorry. Too much. (He looks at the menu for a long time.)

drink.fallback: Uh, no cider? That's okay. Lemonade! It's like cider's summer cousin.
favourite: Uh, apple cider, please! It tastes like autumn. Even in summer!

perfect.text: Uh, hold on, hold on. Nobody touch it. (Click.) Okay. That's going on my wall.
Uh, WOW. Hold on. (Click. Click. Click.) That's a magazine cover, [name]!
Uh, that's perfect! I'm taking a photo! I'm framing it! I'm eating it! In that order!

great.text: Uh, oh, that looks wonderful! The colours! The steam!
Uh, ha! Looks great! Thank you!

okay.text: Uh, yum! A classic. Simple, honest, delicious.

burnt.text: Uh, ooh, that's got character! Very dramatic. I'm calling this one 'Charcoal Dreams.' Ha!
Uh, a little crispy! That's okay! I'll use a filter! Ha!
Ha! Burnt! Very dramatic! Black and white photo!

eating.text: Uh, what do you call a mole who tells jokes? A comedig-an! ...I'm workshopping that one.
Uh, I photographed a beetle on the way here. It was so shiny. Do you want to see? You want to see.
Uh, the best part of any trip is coming home. And coming here. Which is basically home.
Uh, did you know moles can dig a tunnel eighteen feet long in an hour? I can't. But I know it.
(He's quietly photographing the dining room from his seat.)
Uh, hold on. (He photographs his plate from five angles.) Okay. Now I can eat. Ha!
Uh, this is so good I'd give it a ten. On a scale of mole. Which goes to ten. Ha!
(He's laughing quietly at something on his camera.) Sorry! Pigeon photo. It's making a face. Ha!

eating_chat.text: Uh, if you could go anywhere in the world, where would you go?

choices.text: Wherever you're going next. Your trips sound amazing.
choices.reply: Uh, you'd come? Okay, I'm bringing you back so many photos.

choices.text: Somewhere with no bad puns.
choices.reply: Ha! Then you'd have to leave me behind! ...Don't leave me behind.

choices.text: I'm happy right here.
choices.reply: Uh, that's a good answer, honestly. Home's the best destination.

choices.text: Somewhere you're not.
choices.reply: (Laughs, unsure.) Ha... oof. Okay. (He eats quietly.)

eating_chat.text: Uh, if you could go anywhere in the world, where would you go? I'll take you a photo from there!

choices.text: Wherever you're going next. Then I'll feel like I came along.
choices.reply: (Gasps.) Okay, I'm taking SO many pictures for you!

choices.text: The middle of the earth. You'd know the way.
choices.reply: (Snorts.) I DO know the way! It's very dark! Bad for photos!

choices.text: Somewhere with mountains.
choices.reply: Uh, mountains! Great light up there! I'll get you a good one!

choices.text: I don't need photos.
choices.reply: Ha... right. Okay. (He puts the camera down.)

eating_chat.text: Uh, why don't skeletons ever eat at restaurants? They don't have the stomach for it! Ha! ...Too dark?

choices.text: Not too dark. I laughed.
choices.reply: You LAUGHED? Ha! That's two this week! A record!

choices.text: That joke has no body to it.
choices.reply: (Wheezes.) NO BODY! Okay, you win! You win the jokes!

choices.text: A little.
choices.reply: Ha! Okay, back in the drawer it goes.

choices.text: That's not even funny.
choices.reply: (Nervous laugh.) Ha... no. Sorry. (He eats quietly.)

eating_chat.text: Uh, I'm making a photo book of the town! Everyone's in it. Can I put the kitchen in? The kitchen's my favourite.

choices.text: I'd love that. Take as many as you want.
choices.reply: Yay! I'll make it look SO good. Even the sink!

choices.text: Only if you edit out the burnt pans.
choices.reply: (Laughs.) No promises! The burnt pans have character!

choices.text: Sure, after closing.
choices.reply: Uh, perfect! Night light! Very moody!

choices.text: Keep the kitchen out of it.
choices.reply: Oh! Okay. Ha. No kitchen. (He crosses something out.)

eating_chat.text: Uh, I just realised. I don't have a single photo of us. Like, together. Can we? Quick one?

choices.text: Absolutely. Squeeze in.
choices.reply: (Click.) Ha! That's going in a frame! The BIG frame!

choices.text: Only if we both make silly faces.
choices.reply: (Makes the silliest face. Click.) Ha! That's the best photo I've ever taken!

choices.text: Sure. Quick, though.
choices.reply: (Click.) Done! Thanks!

choices.text: I'd rather not.
choices.reply: Oh. Ha. Right. That's fine. (He lowers the camera slowly.)

leaving.text: Uh, I'm off to [trip] tomorrow! Don't miss me too much. Actually, miss me a little.
Uh, thanks, [name]! I'll see you soon. Or I'll see you through a lens!
Uh, okay, I'm off! Gotta hole up at home. Ha! Bye!
Uh, that was delightful. I'm going to go photograph a cloud now.
Uh, bye, [name]! Smile! (Click.) Got it! Ha!
Thanks for the food! I'm off to take pictures of the sunset. Or a bush. Whatever's nearer!
Uh, see you soon! Unless I go on a trip! Then see you later! Ha!

seasons.autumn: Uh, leaves! Acorns! Cider! It's my season, [name]. It's officially my season.
seasons.christmas: Uh, I made everyone calendars with my photos. Here's yours! January is a very nice rock.
seasons.halloween: Uh, I dressed up as a ghost. A ghost photographer. Boo! ...Say cheese!
seasons.spring: Uh, everything's blooming! My camera roll is ninety percent flowers right now.
seasons.summer: Uh, the patio at sunset! The light is unbeatable this time of year.
seasons.winter: Uh, snow makes every photo look magical. Even my boring photos. Especially my boring photos.
